objective: Slay Zhevra Runners to collect 4 Zhevra Hooves for Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.

description: The zhevra, although not the fiercest beast in the Barrens, are a shade tougher than the plainstriders.  Don't worry -- we'll send you against bigger prey in good time, but for now your teeth could use a little more cutting.
Hunt the zhevra to the north and south, and collect their hooves.  Bring them to me and perhaps we'll next send you against something tougher.
progress: How many zhevra have you slain?
completion: Not bad, <name>. Those zhevra hold a lot of strength in their legs. A sharp kick from them can knock even a tauren on its haunches!
It looks like you have some strength in you too. Are you ready for a real challenge?
